title: Do not use polish as proof of authorship
rule: Do not treat punctuation or polish as proof that writing is AI-generated. AI-generated language usually uses specific words or phrases.
example: Assess what a sentence says and whether its wording fits the context.
counterexample: Declare a passage AI-generated solely because it uses an em dash.
rationale: Punctuation and polish alone do not establish authorship.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/general.md`. Examples are illustrative.
